Opinion Galatasaray

Surrender at Papara Park: Okan Buruk's Ninety Minutes Without an Answer

Galatasaray had 54% of the ball and produced three shots on target in ninety minutes. After the 4-0 at Papara Park, the question is not about the players but about the bench: does Okan Buruk have an idea for this team?

Opinion Fenerbahçe

The Manager Who Resigned but Did Not Leave: Five Days at Fenerbahçe Since Roma

In the days after their 1-1 draw with Roma, Fenerbahçe lived through their manager's resignation, his return within forty-eight hours, and the season's first goalless match at Gaziantep. Seven points from five weeks, one point in the Champions League — and a decision still not taken.

Opinion Beşiktaş

Beşiktaş Enter September with Their Wings Spread: What 12 Points at the Top Says

Beşiktaş are top of the Süper Lig with four wins from five: 12 points, +8 goal difference. The Çorum, Kadıköy and Erzurumspor results that followed their only defeat, at Alanya, explain why supporters have earned the right to look at this season differently.
